policy.population: all fixed easy153+medium92=245 frames; four scored arms plus fresh Base/N3 controls
policy.reference: saved evaluation_reference.native_points_px and valid_native_ids; fixed N3_SUBPIX phase
policy.line_error: RMS of two signed normal distances of known proxy native endpoints to the normalized observed infinite line
policy.line_unknown: saved reference matched=False, or either reference endpoint invalid/missing/nonfinite
policy.invalid_observed_line_contract: preserve failed audit; do not turn invalid normals into a valid UNKNOWN factor
policy.consensus_unit: one distinct semantic edge; support query count is a separate quantity
policy.actual_unused_pool: solver.line_edges, independently compared with factor_pool and source checks
policy.consumed: incident edges of actually adopted boundary corners present in allowed point pool
policy.approved_inliers: NEW_POSE and new_pose_estimated and solver.available and solver.state=NEW_POSE only
policy.rejected_candidate_inliers: raw best-candidate diagnostics on baseline fallback; never approved final inliers
policy.point_error: Euclidean distance of saved input_points[corner] to same matched known proxy native reference, threshold8px; nonfinite or [-1,-1] is unknown
policy.dimension_relation: actual returned cf_extents compared with fixed N3 cf_extents at atol1e-9 rtol0; also test [2,1,0] permutation
policy.outcomes: saved T/R/ADDsym deltas only; strict both-better/both-worse; no new pose scoring
policy.rank_scope: stored candidate local geometry only; approved NEW kept separate from rejected candidate
